summary: Donald Trump publicly opposed the proposed bipartisan January 6 commission before the House vote on H.R. 3233. French Hill voted Yea on final passage, opposite Trump's documented position.
reviewNotes: House Clerk roll call establishes Hill's vote and the party split. Contemporaneous reporting quotes Trump's opposition statement and identifies Hill among the 35 Republicans who voted for the commission.
